Local Map

You trace the road with a fingertip and compare the inked ridge to the skyline.

Rules

ID: item-local-map

Market price: 5 coins. Bulk: 1.

A map and protective case. Contains the publicly known routes the seller actually knows; no secret discoveries or guaranteed accuracy.

Buying equipment grants no DP advancement, training or ability. Use normal item-handling actions unless an applicable card says otherwise.
